purpose: Structured telemetry hooks for production one-active-deity battlefield tuning, replayability analysis, difficulty gates, and boss fail-point diagnosis.

counters.turns: Round count reached before victory, defeat, or quit.
counters.damageTaken: Total incoming and hazard damage applied to active deity.
counters.reactionSuccessRate: Resolved successful reactions divided by opened reaction windows.
counters.objectiveCompletionRate: Completed objectives divided by objective count.
counters.momentumEfficiency: Damage plus objective progress per Momentum spent.
counters.divinityEfficiency: Boss phase clears plus signature value per Divinity spent.
counters.hazardDamageShare: Hazard damage divided by all damage taken.
counters.bossPhaseFailPoints: Count of failed boss phase telemetry keys by phase.
counters.replayabilityScore: Weighted mix of route diversity, objective timing variance, reaction choices, and resource spend diversity.

qualityGates: Every battle start creates a telemetry run id.
Every reducer that changes battle state emits at least one event log row.
Every resource gain and spend is countered by resource and source.
Every reaction window records opened, resolved, success, and decline counts.
Every objective completion records objective id, progress, and reward source.
Every boss phase emits reached and cleared or failed telemetry.
Telemetry summaries must be deterministic for identical reducer scripts.
